answer: Miscellaneous >> History & Biography Question ID: 50882 Country: India Title: was MAlik Bin DInar sahabee or tabeen Question: My question is that was Malik Bin Dinar a Sahabi or Tabeyi? Please give me detailed information related to this person. Also tell me which book should I consult regarding the biographies of Sahabas or Tabiyin? Answer ID: 50882 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 355/L=91/TL=04/1435) (1) Yes, Malik Ibn Dinar was a Tabiye, not a Sahabi. (2) In order to know the history of Sahaba and Tabiyeen you should study the books: Seeratut Tabiyeen, Siyarus Sahaba, Siyarus Sahabiyat and Hayatus Sahaba etc. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
